catalog.title: Inheritance
catalog.description: Family property, evidence, neighbours, court, and tomato-adjacent law — now with considerably more ways the tomatoes can end up owned.
catalog.contentNotice: Family conflict, police and court proceedings, property damage, bribery-adjacent humor, and abandonment.

strings.inheritance.campaign.description: A village property dispute across evidence, neighbours, police, lawyers, court, settlement, and the specific afterlife of a disputed tomato patch.
strings.inheritance.campaign.title: Inheritance
strings.inheritance.ending_abandonment.text:
The House Without an Heir

You walk away. Grass crosses the disputed line before any relative does.
strings.inheritance.ending_archivist_becomes_fam:
The Archivist Comes to Christmas

The archivist takes such a personal interest in untangling your family's paperwork that he gets invited to the settlement lunch, then the next name day, then, eventually, every family gathering going forward.
strings.inheritance.ending_buyout.text:
One Owner, Five Receipts

You buy the remaining shares and inherit the roof, the tomatoes, and all future unsolicited advice about both.
strings.inheritance.ending_court_victory.text:
The Court Record

The judgment settles ownership across twelve pages. Nobody in the family reads them the same way twice.
strings.inheritance.ending_everyone_settles_but_:
Ownership Resolved, Tomatoes Unresolved

The paperwork is signed, witnessed, and filed. Your aunt continues tending the tomatoes as though none of it happened, and honestly, at this point, nobody has the nerve to stop her.
strings.inheritance.ending_family_peace.text:
The Table After Court

You use the archivist's note to offer dignity alongside the facts. Lunch, remarkably, becomes possible again.
strings.inheritance.ending_family_war.text:
The Inheritance War

The police report keeps the facts straight while the family perfects every other available kind of damage.
strings.inheritance.ending_informal_settlement_o:
Solved on the Doorstep, Unofficially

Two cousins who haven't spoken in a decade end up on the same doorstep at midnight, share a bottle, and settle the whole thing verbally. Nobody writes it down. Somehow, it holds.
strings.inheritance.ending_lawyer_bills_more_tha:
A Technical Victory

You win outright. The legal fees, once totalled, exceed the land's assessed value by a margin nobody wants to say out loud at the next family lunch.
strings.inheritance.ending_mediation_becomes_a_s:
A New Argument, About the Old One

The mediation session resolves the property question and opens an entirely new argument about who mediated it better. This one has no deed to settle it.
strings.inheritance.ending_police_file_grows_a_l:
The Report Outlives the Dispute

New complaints keep getting attached to the same case file — a car, a fence, a goat — until the file is thicker than the deed ever was, and nobody remembers exactly what it was originally about.
strings.inheritance.ending_settlement.text:
The Village Settlement

The signatures do not create affection, but they do create a boundary everyone can live beside.
strings.inheritance.ending_the_house_becomes_a_r:
Nobody Wins, Everybody Gets a Cut

Exhausted by the whole affair, the family agrees to rent the house out and split the income evenly. It is, everyone privately admits, the most functional decision the family has made in thirty years.
strings.inheritance.ending_the_missing_deed_name:
A Third Cousin You've Never Met

The recovered deed does settle everything — in favour of a third cousin currently living in Chicago who has never once mentioned owning a tomato patch in Bulgaria.
strings.inheritance.ending_the_village_writes_a_:
Now It's Folklore

The dispute becomes such a fixture of village conversation that someone sets it to a chalga tune at the next wedding. You are, technically, famous now. This does not help with the tomatoes.
strings.inheritance.neighbour_route_1.push: Let the 1994 story run its course
strings.inheritance.neighbour_route_1.text: Your mother supplies names, dates, and a forensically detailed account of who failed to bring salad to a gathering in 1994.
strings.inheritance.neighbour_route_2.improvise: Negotiate with the calmest branch first
strings.inheritance.neighbour_route_2.text: The oldest neighbour in the village remembers the boundary before the fence, and the agreement before the argument that replaced it.
strings.inheritance.neighbour_route_3.favour: Call in the favour you earned
strings.inheritance.neighbour_route_3.favour_fai: No one owes you that favour yet.
strings.inheritance.neighbour_route_3.text: A village meeting slowly turns testimony into negotiation, while coffee keeps everyone technically, if reluctantly, still seated.
strings.inheritance.neighbour_route_4.ending_med: A New Argument, About the Old One
strings.inheritance.neighbour_route_4.text: The family can now settle, trade shares, or preserve the dispute as its most durable and beloved tradition.
strings.inheritance.neighbour_route_event_1.text: The day contributes its own amendment.
strings.inheritance.neighbour_route_event_1a.tex: A forgotten photograph dates the old fence precisely, and includes everyone smiling beside it, apparently on good terms once.
strings.inheritance.neighbour_route_event_1b.tex: The story expands to include a christening, a feud, and a wedding, and loses the actual parcel entirely somewhere in the middle.
strings.inheritance.neighbour_route_event_2.text: A seeded interruption arrives on schedule.
strings.inheritance.neighbour_route_event_2a.tex: Two co-owners arrive ready to settle, purely because the last bus home leaves at four.
strings.inheritance.neighbour_route_event_2b.pro: Offer to buy the smallest shares
strings.inheritance.neighbour_route_event_2b.tex: A cousin arrives late with a secret agreement handwritten on hotel stationery from a hotel nobody can place.
strings.inheritance.police_route_1.text: The new padlock yields immediately to a bolt cutter. The family WhatsApp group achieves full operational readiness within the minute.
strings.inheritance.police_route_2.text: Police record the fence, the lock, the missing deeds, and six mutually exclusive versions of what happened last Tuesday.
strings.inheritance.police_route_3.favour: Call in the favour you earned
strings.inheritance.police_route_3.favour_fail: No one owes you that favour yet.
strings.inheritance.police_route_3.text: Property condition itself becomes evidence: broken windows, a suspiciously well-repaired roof, cultivated tomatoes, and one room nobody in the family will claim.
strings.inheritance.police_route_4.ending_the_ho: Nobody Wins, Everybody Gets a Cut
strings.inheritance.police_route_4.text: The report prevents outright invention, but not anger. You must decide whether the house is worth the war it has now officially documented.
strings.inheritance.police_route_event_1.text: The day contributes its own amendment.
strings.inheritance.police_route_event_1a.text: The responding officer recognizes the parcel from an older boundary complaint and pulls up its diagram from memory.
strings.inheritance.police_route_event_1b.procee: Argue that family matters need no report
strings.inheritance.police_route_event_1b.text: A cousin removes the cut lock and quietly replaces it with a considerably larger one before sunset.
strings.inheritance.police_route_event_2.text: A seeded interruption arrives on schedule.
strings.inheritance.police_route_event_2a.procee: Offer the property to the other branch
strings.inheritance.police_route_event_2a.text: The damp wall reveals an older, bricked-up doorway that matches the original deed plan exactly.
strings.inheritance.police_route_event_2b.text: A storm damages the roof overnight, making every single negotiating position more expensive by morning.
strings.inheritance.property_inheritance.choice_: Hear the neighbours before challenging tomato law
Ask family and neighbours what happened
Take the papers directly to a lawyer
Cut the padlock and force the issue
strings.inheritance.property_inheritance.text: Your aunt says she owns the entire property because she has personally maintained the tomatoes since 1998. The news arrives with one missing deed, five confident relatives, and a WhatsApp group that has not slept in three days.
strings.inheritance.records_route_1.listen: Let the archivist explain the annotations
strings.inheritance.records_route_1.text: The cadastral archive holds three plans: old, older, and the one everyone cites confidently and nobody can actually unfold.
strings.inheritance.records_route_2.text: A lost deed surfaces in a municipal index filed under your grandfather's second, more creative spelling of his own name.
strings.inheritance.records_route_3.favour: Call in the favour you earned
strings.inheritance.records_route_3.favour_fail: No one owes you that favour yet.
strings.inheritance.records_route_3.text: The lawyer compares signatures while the family compares memories; neither exercise produces anything resembling silence.
strings.inheritance.records_route_4.ending_the_m: A Third Cousin You've Never Met
strings.inheritance.records_route_4.text: In court, evidence and folklore finally sit at separate tables. You decide exactly how hard a legal victory should be allowed to land.
strings.inheritance.records_route_event_1.text: The day contributes its own amendment.
strings.inheritance.records_route_event_1a.text: The archivist recognizes a notation linking the missing deed to exactly the right parcel, and looks faintly proud of himself.
strings.inheritance.records_route_event_1b.text: Your photographs include, beautifully and entirely uselessly, the wrong village's map.
strings.inheritance.records_route_event_2.text: A seeded interruption arrives on schedule.
strings.inheritance.records_route_event_2a.proce: Ask the lawyer for settlement terms
strings.inheritance.records_route_event_2a.text: The surveyor finds the old boundary stone under a raspberry bush, exactly where the oldest neighbour swore it would be.
strings.inheritance.records_route_event_2b.text: A witness cancels, then sends a voice message considerably longer than the hearing itself would have taken.
